items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I got quite a bit of recognition working with Benny Goodman, the Benny Goodman Sextet.

ctx.x: Well, I mean besides Benny Goodman to you.

Oh, Benny Goodman. Well, anyway, Benny was very good to work with. I knew how to handle him, you know, and, of course, I stayed out of his way, one thing. That's how we got along so very well. Benny was really a taskmaster, you know, so -- he wants everything perfect, and
if you're not doing the right, playing the right notes to suit him, what have you, he goes four eyes. He'll get that glare, you know. That's what they used to call him, a four eye, the glare.
